composition_variation: Portray an original 34-year-old anime woman with a neat copper pixie cut, standing in a bright architecture loft with rolled blank drawing paper under one arm. She wears an opaque olive overshirt over a cream turtleneck, charcoal trousers, and simple sneakers. Use precise editorial linework, warm plywood textures, clean ivory geometry, and soft north-window light. Her free hand rests on her hip in a composed capable stance. Build an original peaceful portrait wallpaper, never a replica of existing artwork. Keep the upper 28% empty and quiet for the clock. Design at 1024x1536 for the central x158-866 crop, with the face inside x240-784. No text, logos, UI, weapons, violence, or extra characters.
